interpretation: Wave55 exactly reproduces Wave54. The dedicated February-trained opponent ordering reaches its best all-210 diagnostic ROI at 3 tickets/race: 27 trifecta hits among 71 head wins, 38.03% conditional capture, ROI 106.89%. One ticket is also slightly positive at 106.52% but only 12/71 capture. Expanding to 5 tickets raises capture to 50.70% but ROI falls to 88.58%; broad ticket expansion is not attractive. This is diagnostic March evaluation only, not production evidence.
